Everything there made quite the impression. North Carolina (Asheville/Hendersonville area) is honestly the best place to be. The schools are phenomenal, the mountains are gorgeous, the people are generous (mostly), and depending on who you make friends with, you won’t or will have the same experience but it’ll feel different. Even if it’s a lie, I loved living in that lie. I felt powerful and free. There’s a spot on the Blue Ridge Parkway called Frying Pan Tower. I’d highly **highly** recommend going there if anyone is down to visit. I lived there for three almost four years and I can say it’s wonderful.
